conviction_note: The customer-capex evidence published since ASML last spoke on 15 July all points to a firm Q4 guide and a strong first word on 2027: TSMC capex raised to $60-64B, Micron's H1 FY27 capex about equal to its whole FY26, Samsung's record Q3, and TSMC's Q3 revenue above the top of its guide. Against that, the bar is high: 2027 consensus is about EUR 54.7B (+24%), and brokers have raised 2027 WFE to +38-45%. This name also has a history of selling its beats: rebuilt from 6 confirmed prints, it fell on 4 of them (median |move| 2.56%), and the average across its last 5 earnings days was -1.6%. The tape into the print is fragile: -7.4% over 5 days on AI-financing worries, and the shares sit below a cited gamma flip. The upside-paid skew already agrees with the positive lean. So p_up is only 55, and abs_move stays at the option-implied ~5% rather than being shrunk. The scaled number (+0.5) and the findings' sum (+0.2) agree in sign and are both small: the evidence is mostly public and offsetting.

Sell-side Q3 revenue consensus is about EUR 11.62-11.7B, from two broadly agreeing sources: moomoo preview 2026-10-12 (EUR 11.62B, GM 55.7%, https://www.moomoo.com/community/feed/asml-earnings-preview-can-55-sales-growth-still-surprise-wall-117425121460230) and Tickeron (~EUR 11.7B, EPS ~EUR 10.67, https://tickeron.com/earnings/ASML/). Dollar-basis EPS consensus ranges $12.01-12.47. FY26 guide EUR 43-45B implies a Q4 of ~EUR 14.2-14.4B (Q1 8.8 + Q2 9.33 + Q3); the market's Q4 estimate is ~EUR 14.05B per moomoo. 2027 sales consensus averages ~EUR 54.67B (range 43.6-60.7B, 38 analysts) per Yahoo Finance as relayed in search, https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ASML/analysis/ (snippet_only). The stock trades on the Q4 guide and the first 2027 statement, not on Q3.
positioning_check: Short interest is tiny and not crowded: 1,132,572 shares, 0.33% of float, ~1 day to cover, as of the 2026-06-30 settlement (Benzinga, https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/ASML/short-interest, snippet_only; no fresher settlement found). Baseline 25-delta skew is -7.75 vol points (upside paid), with put/call OI at 1.15. Event-implied move is 5.07% (straddle 5.52%, ATM IV 66%). Moomoo (2026-10-12) describes call volume and OI above puts, a gamma flip at $1,735.79, and a $1,700 put wall. Spot sealed at $1,697.79, so the stock closed below the gamma flip and on the put wall: dealer hedging now amplifies moves in both directions. The run-up is -7.43% over 5 days and +6.68% over 20, and the stock is 14.7% off its 52-week high.

findings.finding: Customers have firmed their capex since ASML's 15 July print, and this supports a Q4 guide at or above the ~EUR 14.2B the FY guide implies, plus a strong first 2027 statement. TSMC raised its 2026 capex to $60-64B from ~$56B on 16 July and said 3-year capex would be 'significantly higher'. TSMC's Q3 revenue of NT$1.494T beat the top of its guide (Sept monthly report, 8 Oct). Micron guided H1 FY27 capex to ~$25B against $27.4B for all of FY26 (late Sept). Samsung pre-announced a record Q3 operating profit of KRW 107.4T against a KRW 106.64T consensus (8 Oct). All of this came after ASML last spoke, and the 2027 consensus of ~EUR 54.7B (+24%) may not fully reflect it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (15 Jul): FY guide raised from EUR 36-40B to 43-45B plus the 2027 capacity plan, stock +2.23%. Q1 2026 (15 Apr): FY raised, stock -2.41% because the China share shrank. Oct 2025: a 2026 'not below 2025' statement, stock +2.71%. Jul 2025: 2026 growth not confirmed, stock -8.33%. The forward statement is the line this name trades on, and it is asymmetric: a withheld growth confirmation costs far more than a confirmation pays.
findings.why_not_priced: Each datum is public, and the read-through to ASML's Q4 guide and 2027 number is the market's job. But the stock fell 7.4% in the 5 days into the print on sector AI-financing worries, not on any ASML datum, while the customer series improved. If the market had priced the customer data, ASML would not be trading below its gamma flip with 2027 consensus at only +24% while the brokers' WFE estimates sit at +38%.

Samsung Q3 guidance (2026-10-08): https://www.samsung.com/global/ir/reports-disclosures/public-disclosure-view.84775/ . TSMC September revenue (2026-10-08): https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/3343 . They are proxies for ASML's order book, not ASML's own numbers.

findings.finding: The 2027 bar has been raised by the sell side since July, so a qualitative 'strong growth' statement may not clear it. JPMorgan lifted 2027 WFE to +38% ($224.5B) on 18-19 Sept, citing DRAM and TSMC capex; Goldman lifted 2027 WFE growth to +45% and Morgan Stanley to $202B. The JPM note expects ASML to give initial 2027 guidance with Q3. ASML's own 2027 framework is +30% low-NA EUV units (~65 to ~85) and +30% DUV immersion, with 2027 low-NA 'close to fully covered'. Against WFE at +38-45%, a 2027 ASML statement of +20-25% would read as share loss or as a capacity ceiling.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the first-look forward statement: Oct 2025 (+2.71%) cleared a low bar, and Jul 2025 (-8.33%) missed it. Here the bar is high and set by broker WFE numbers, not by the company.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-19 (year inferred from context; the page shows Sept 18/19 without a year)
findings.why_not_priced: This sets the expectation rather than being an unpriced fact. It enters only through the gap between broker WFE growth (+38-45%) and ASML's capacity-bound unit growth (+30%) plus pricing. If the market already expected ASML to grow below WFE, 2027 consensus would not have drifted up with the WFE revisions (11 up, 0 down on Q3 estimates in 30 days per 24/7 Wall St).
findings.independence: Proactive Investors on the JPM expectation that ASML gives initial 2027 guidance with Q3: https://www.proactiveinvestors.co.uk/a/45352134/jp-morgan-expects-asml-to-signal-strong-2027-demand-as-stock-trades-at-u (snippet_only; date not visible). ASML's capacity numbers come from the Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000937966/000162828026048235/pressreleasefinancialresul.htm). This finding shares the WFE theme with finding 1 but argues the bar, not the demand.

findings.finding: Reported quarter: ASML beat the top of its Q2 guide (EUR 9.33B against 8.4-9.0B, GM 54.0% against a 51-52% guide), and installed-base sales were ~EUR 300M above guidance. Q3 consensus of ~EUR 11.62-11.7B sits only just above the EUR 11.5B guide midpoint. A repeat of Q2's beat pattern puts Q3 near EUR 12.0B, about +3% over consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has not paid for beats. 24/7 Wall St puts the average earnings-day move at -1.6% across the last 5 reports despite 4 straight EPS beats. Q1 2026 beat consensus by 8% on revenue and 12% on EPS, and the stock fell 2.41%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Consensus has drifted up (11 up, 0 down in 30 days), but it still sits in the lower half of the dollar-converted guide. A beat lands inside what the company guided, so it is worth little on its own.
findings.independence: 24/7 Wall St on revisions and beats (2026-10-12): https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/12/why-october-14-could-change-everything-for-asml-stock/ . The Q2 guide-vs-actual figures come from ASML's own releases: Q1 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000937966/000162828026025147/pressreleasefinancialresul.htm .

findings.finding: Pricing power has widened since July, a 2027 margin lever. The Elec, relayed around 9-10 Oct 2026, reports that ASML will raise spare-part prices for EUV and DUV tools by a uniform 10% for Samsung and SK hynix from January 2027, and that both accepted. That followed The Information's 15 July report that some Chinese customers accepted a ~10% price rise on mature DUV tools. On the Q2 call the CFO cited 'better pricing power'. ASML has not confirmed either report.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on pricing. The closest is Q2 2026, where a GM beat (54.0% against a 51-52% guide) came with a +2.23% day.
findings.why_not_priced: A Korean trade-press scoop from four days before the print, landing in a week when the whole sector sold off. It only reaches the price if management quantifies or confirms it, for example in a 2027 GM comment. Had it been priced, 2027 GM expectations would sit above the Q3/Q4 ~56% run-rate, and no source found says they do.
findings.independence: TrendForce on the July DUV price report: https://www.trendforce.com/news/2026/07/16/news-asml-reportedly-seeks-higher-tool-prices-as-tsmc-pushes-back-mature-duv-tools-could-see-10-hike/ . TSMC reportedly pushed back on price rises, which cuts against the largest customer paying more.

findings.finding: The tape into the print is fragile, and the reaction function on good forward news is damped. Starting 8 Oct, chip stocks sold off on AI-financing worries (an OpenAI financing report, the Philadelphia semiconductor index -3.4% that day). Rates and oil above $105 added pressure, and the CXMT/China competition worry returned. ASML fell 1.7% on 12 Oct and 3.1% on 13 Oct, closing at $1,697.79 (-7.4% over 5 days), below the cited $1,735.79 gamma flip and at the $1,700 put wall. Bloomberg (13 Oct) framed ASML's guidance as key to restoring confidence in a 'fragile chip trade'. In that tape a confirming print can be sold, as in July 2025, and a strong one can trigger a relief move. On net, the sector beta carries a slight downward lean.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Earnings-day average -1.6% across the last 5 reports. Apr 2025 (-7.06%) and Apr 2026 (-2.41%) both fell on a macro or China overlay despite solid numbers.
findings.why_not_priced: The drawdown is the price; this finding is about how the print will be received, not about new information. The baseline's upside-paid skew suggests options are positioned for a relief rally. If sector beta were fully priced out, the stock would not be trading on the same day's Kospi -5.5% and SOX moves.
findings.independence: Bloomberg, 2026-10-13: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-13/asml-s-guidance-key-to-instill-confidence-in-fragile-chip-trade (headline only). The 8 Oct SOX drop and Citi's AI-capex view: https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262206781-us-ai-hardware-stock-drop-citigroup-capex-divergence-semiconductor-q3-earnings-sandisk-micron-tradingkey . The gamma flip and put wall: moomoo preview (2026-10-12).

findings.finding: China and export controls stay an open overhang that the call will be asked about. The MATCH Act, which extends US controls to ASML's DUV immersion at covered Chinese fabs with servicing licences, had bipartisan support and was headed for the defence bill as of 20 Aug (NL Times). Media reported around 12-13 Oct that the Dutch government pushed back on automatic alignment. Management guides China to ~20% of 2026 sales, down from 33% in 2025. Q1 2026 fell on a China-share surprise (19% against 36% the quarter before).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (15 Apr): stock -2.41% despite a raised FY guide, attributed to the shrinking China share (Yahoo: 'ASML stock drops 6% as China segment takes hit', intraday). Apr 2025: -7.06% on new China export restrictions.
findings.why_not_priced: The legislation itself is public and does not resolve inside the window. What the print can add is the Q3 China share and any 2027 China assumption, which would show up as a lower 2027 base. No newer document on legislative progress was found.
findings.independence: ad-hoc-news, 2026-10-13, on the Dutch pushback (same document as finding 5's source, a different item in it). 24/7 Wall St on China at ~20% of 2026 sales.

findings.finding: TSMC committed on 8 Sept 2026 to bring ASML's High-NA EUV into high-volume manufacturing from 2030, with a joint 12-inch-mask initiative, and Samsung's commitment is similar. Earlier in 2026 TSMC had said it had no High-NA plans for A13/A12. This lengthens the High-NA revenue runway; ASML expects to recognise 4-5 High-NA systems in 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print has turned on High-NA adoption news.
findings.why_not_priced: It is long-dated (2030) and was published a month ago, so it is mostly priced. It reaches the print only if management quantifies High-NA orders or the 2028+ outlook.

lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): the reported-quarter beat finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3, because this name's last 5 earnings days averaged -1.6% despite beats.

Rule 7 (positioning): the positive lean agrees with the upside-paid skew, so p_up moved from 56 to 55. Short interest was checked (0.33% of float), not crowded, so the negative findings were left unshrunk.

Rule on untrustworthy history for FPIs: the base rate was rebuilt from 6 confirmed results dates (median |move| 2.56%). This was already done in the draft, so it changed nothing more; abs_move stays on the option-implied 5.07%.
Rule 6 (verify the bar): the bar was sourced to the company guide plus two broadly agreeing consensus sources. No cap was applied.
